morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整的外来饮品名称记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。所列音标为英语读法；输入未提供马来语官方音标、音节或爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 玛格丽塔鸡尾酒：通常以龙舌兰酒、橙味利口酒和青柠汁调成的含酒精饮品。
senses.en_definition: An alcoholic cocktail typically made with tequila, orange-flavoured liqueur and lime juice.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis koktel beralkohol yang lazimnya dibuat daripada tequila, likur berperisa oren dan jus limau nipis.
senses.nuances: 这里按饮品名释义；大写 Margarita 也可能是人名，须依上下文判断。status 表示马来语官方收录状态尚未核实，马来语释义为编辑性解释。英语发音见 [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english-spanish/margarita)；配料实例见 [IHG 饮品菜单](https://www.ihg.com/hotelmedia/repository/concierge/MLEKF/296/1/6028/2594071328_Beverage%20Menu.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menu restoran itu menyenaraikan margarita sebagai koktel beralkohol yang mengandungi tequila.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该餐厅的菜单将玛格丽塔列为含龙舌兰酒的酒精鸡尾酒。
dual_scenarios.en: The restaurant’s menu lists the margarita as an alcoholic cocktail containing tequila.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak margarita satu, yang biasa je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak memesan segelas margarita biasa sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我要一杯玛格丽塔，普通款就行。
dual_scenarios.en: I’ll have a margarita, just the regular one.
spoken_features: margarita satu 采用口语点单语序

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak margarita satu, yang biasa je. Kau nak apa?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak memesan segelas margarita biasa sahaja. Awak hendak memesan apa?
messages.zh: 我要一杯普通玛格丽塔。你要什么？
messages.en: I’ll have a regular margarita. What would you like?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku jus oren je lah. Dah pesan makanan belum?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak jus oren sahaja. Adakah makanan sudah dipesan?
messages.zh: 我喝橙汁就好啦。吃的点了吗？
messages.en: Just orange juice for me. Have we ordered food yet?

etymology.historical_story: Margarita is recorded as a cocktail name derived from the Spanish feminine name Margarita, corresponding to Margaret. The name travels intact across languages because menus identify a particular drink rather than translate its ingredients. This explains its appearance in Malay sentences without Malay affixes; it does not establish official Malay dictionary recognition. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/margarita)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: margarita 对应中文“玛格丽塔”：想象杯边一圈盐、杯里青柠香，记住这是鸡尾酒名称。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 点单可说 Saya ingin memesan segelas margarita。与不熟悉的人交谈时，不宜默认对方饮酒。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在马来西亚的多宗教社交场合，应尊重对方的饮食选择。普通 margarita 含酒精；需要无酒精版本时，应明确询问配料和制作方式。
